newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI to divest 25 pct in bank unit.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI to divest 25 pct in bank unit.

text.p: Term-lending institution Industrial Credit & Investment Corp of India (ICICI) on Friday said it would offer for sale 25 percent of shares in ICICI Banking Corp at a price of 35 rupees per share.

"The draft Letter of Offer for sale of equity shares has been filed with the Securities & Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Offer for Sale is expected to open for public subscription by the last week of July 1997," ICICI said in a statement released late on Friday.
ICICI Bank's paid-up capital comprises 150 million equity shares issued at par and 15 million shares will be issued to ICICI at the same offer price, the statement said.
"The issue of the additional shares will enable ICICI Bank to purchase from ICICI some of the office premises presently occupied by it," it added.
In addition, 2.25 million shares are also being offered for sale to employees of ICICI, ICICI Bank and other group companies, the statement added.
